title: Explicit Inductive Bias for Transfer Learning with Convolutional Networks (L2-SP)
mechanism: Replace weight decay toward zero with an L2 penalty toward the pretrained weights, keeping the fine-tuned model near the source solution.
adaptation: Encoder only, alpha grid {1e-3,1e-2,1e-1}; decoder keeps wd 1e-4. Simplest feature-preserving arm; the baseline that SPD improves on.
evidence: Recommends L2-SP as the baseline penalty for transfer. In SPD's PASCAL seg table: L2-SP 73.47 ID / 56.70 OOD mIoU vs vanilla FT 66.03 / 44.00.
min_experiment: Arm L2-SP vs SUP100-PF and vs house, seeds 5-9. Co-primaries as for SPD. Kill if no gain over PF on E1 inactive IoU or test relF1@2 and no gain over house on test.
prior_overlap: Partial: PF removes encoder weight decay and lowers lr but has no pull toward init. L2-SP itself never run.

alt_notes.adaptation: Encoder L2-SP alpha in {1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1} with the house lr; decoder plain wd 1e-4; conv1 reference = the summed 1-channel ImageNet kernel. Separates PF's freeze, low lr and no-wd components.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + encoder L2-SP (best alpha on val, 5 seeds). Baseline: SUP100-PF and house. Metric: E1 inactive IoU, E1 crack relF1@2, test crack relF1@2. Kill: not better than PF on any co-primary.
